abilities.desc_en: Passive

abilities.title_en: Whenever a Debuff is Purified, gain a {{var_1}} Melee Damage Buff for {{var_2}}.
abilities.desc_zh: 每当 Debuff 被净化时，就会为 {{var_2}} 获得 {{var_1}} 近战伤害增益。
abilities.desc_en: Whenever a Debuff is Purified, gain a {{var_1}} Melee Damage Buff for {{var_2}}.

abilities.title_en: Unstoppable against basic Melee Attacks while Sidestepping.
abilities.desc_zh: 闪避时无法阻挡基本的近战攻击。
abilities.desc_en: Unstoppable against basic Melee Attacks while Sidestepping.

abilities.title_en: After knocking the enemy out of their ground vehicle form, gain a {{var_3}} Armor and {{var_4}} Melee Attack Buff for {{var_5}}.
abilities.desc_zh: 将敌人从地面车辆形态中击倒后，获得 {{var_3}} 装甲和 {{var_5}} 的 {{var_4}} 近战攻击增益。
abilities.desc_en: After knocking the enemy out of their ground vehicle form, gain a {{var_3}} Armor and {{var_4}} Melee Attack Buff for {{var_5}}.

abilities.desc_zh: 所有攻击
abilities.desc_en: All Attacks

abilities.title_en: +{{var_6}} Attack when striking a Bot in their ground vehicle form.
abilities.desc_zh: +{{var_6}} 攻击地面车辆形态的机器人时进行攻击。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_6}} Attack when striking a Bot in their ground vehicle form.

abilities.desc_zh: 雷霆无法造成暴击。
abilities.desc_en: Thundercracker cannot land Critical Hits.

abilities.title_en: Whenever Thundercracker would increase Critical Damage, he instead increases Attack by {{var_7}} of the amount of Critical Damage that would have been added.
abilities.desc_zh: 每当雷霆增加暴击伤害时，他都会将原本会增加的暴击伤害的攻击力增加 {{var_7}}。
abilities.desc_en: Whenever Thundercracker would increase Critical Damage, he instead increases Attack by {{var_7}} of the amount of Critical Damage that would have been added.

abilities.title_en: Successful melee hits refresh all Melee Buffs on Thundercracker.
abilities.desc_zh: 成功的近战攻击会刷新雷霆雷上的所有近战增益。
abilities.desc_en: Successful melee hits refresh all Melee Buffs on Thundercracker.

abilities.title_en: Sidestepping after a melee attack also refreshes all Melee Buffs.
abilities.desc_zh: 近战攻击后回避也会刷新所有近战增益。
abilities.desc_en: Sidestepping after a melee attack also refreshes all Melee Buffs.

abilities.desc_zh: 被动
abilities.desc_en: Passive

abilities.title_en: Entering the aerial alternate form Purifies Shock, Burn, Bleed, Backfire, and Daze Debuffs.
abilities.desc_zh: 进入空中替代形态可净化触电、烧伤、流血、逆火和晕眩减益。
abilities.desc_en: Entering the aerial alternate form Purifies Shock, Burn, Bleed, Backfire, and Daze Debuffs.

abilities.desc_zh: 重击
abilities.desc_en: Heavy Attacks

abilities.title_en: For each Debuff Purified in this way, this attack inflicts a Burn Debuff causing {{var_8}} Attack as heat damage over {{var_9}}.
abilities.desc_zh: 对于以这种方式净化的每个减益，此攻击会造成燃烧减益，导致 {{var_8}} 攻击对 {{var_9}} 造成热伤害。
abilities.desc_en: For each Debuff Purified in this way, this attack inflicts a Burn Debuff causing {{var_8}} Attack as heat damage over {{var_9}}.

abilities.desc_zh: 远程攻击
abilities.desc_en: Ranged Attacks

abilities.title_en: Gain a {{var_10}} Melee Damage Buff for {{var_11}}.
abilities.desc_zh: 为 {{var_11}} 获得 {{var_10}} 近战伤害增益。
abilities.desc_en: Gain a {{var_10}} Melee Damage Buff for {{var_11}}.

abilities.desc_zh: 阻塞
abilities.desc_en: Blocking

abilities.desc_zh: +{{var_12}} 对抗近战攻击的格挡熟练度。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_12}} Block Proficiency against melee attacks.

abilities.title_en: An additional +{{var_13}} Block Proficiency against the melee attacks of ground vehicles.
abilities.desc_zh: 对抗地面车辆近战攻击的额外 +{{var_13}} 格挡熟练度。
abilities.desc_en: An additional +{{var_13}} Block Proficiency against the melee attacks of ground vehicles.

abilities.title_en: While above {{var_14}} Health, Block cannot be broken by attacks from Bots in their ground vehicle form.
abilities.desc_zh: 当生命值高于 {{var_14}} 时，区块无法被地面车辆形式的机器人的攻击所破坏。
abilities.desc_en: While above {{var_14}} Health, Block cannot be broken by attacks from Bots in their ground vehicle form.

abilities.title_en: Well-timed Blocks against ground vehicles grant a {{var_15}} Melee Buff for {{var_16}} and knock opponents out of their vehicle form.
abilities.desc_zh: 针对地面车辆的适时格挡可为 {{var_16}} 提供 {{var_15}} 近战增益，并将对手击出车辆形态。
abilities.desc_en: Well-timed Blocks against ground vehicles grant a {{var_15}} Melee Buff for {{var_16}} and knock opponents out of their vehicle form.

abilities.title_zh: 飞升-雷霆通过对抗减益、增强近战命中以及增加对强敌的伤害来证明他的近战价值。
abilities.title_en: Ascension- Thundercracker proves his melee worth by fighting off Debuffs, enhancing melee hits, and increasing his damage against tough opponents.
abilities.desc_zh:
所有攻击：

在未减益的情况下，每进行 5 次连续近战攻击都会为 {{var_18}} 提供 {{var_17}} 近战增益。

每个招牌能力等级的近战攻击都有 {{var_19}} 几率来净化任何减益。

每场战斗开始时，针对每个招牌能力等级，将敌人的额外攻击力增加 {{var_20}} 点。

+ 每级大约 {{var_21}}
abilities.desc_en:
Ascension- Thundercracker proves his melee worth by fighting off Debuffs, enhancing melee hits, and increasing his damage against tough opponents.
All Attacks:
Every 5 consecutive melee attacks dealt while not Debuffed grants a {{var_17}} Melee Buff for {{var_18}}.
Melee attacks have an {{var_19}} chance per each Signature Ability Level to Purify any Debuff.
At the start of each fight, increase Attack by {{var_20}} of the enemies’ bonus Attack for each Signature Ability Level.
+ about {{var_21}} per level

abilities.desc_zh: 复仇降临于那些为此而战的人。
abilities.desc_en: Inferiority Complexion - Vengence comes to those who fight for it.

abilities.desc_zh: 每次射弹命中都会为 {{var_23}} 提供 {{var_22}} 近战增益。
abilities.desc_en: Each projectile hit grants a {{var_22}} Melee Buff for {{var_23}}.

abilities.desc_zh: 当你的敌人认为你已陷入绝境时……粉碎他们。
abilities.desc_en: Brutal Treachery - When your enemies think you're cornered... crush them.

abilities.desc_zh: +{{var_29}}~{{var_30}} 伤害和 {{var_31}}~{{var_32}} 所有霸天虎远程攻击的穿甲。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_29}}~{{var_30}} Damage and {{var_31}}~{{var_32}} Armor Piercing for all Decepticon Ranged Attacks.
+{{var_33}}~{{var_34}} Anti-Evade

abilities.desc_zh: 作为领导的灯塔，所有较低级别的队友都获得 +{{var_35}} 攻击评级。
abilities.desc_en: Acting as a beacon of leadership, all lower tier teammates gain +{{var_35}} Attack Rating.
